1 admitted: 1.00 SOL from authority to s1

and the attempt bounces back. Dry run: nothing was built, signed or sent.
The static frame, and the frame under reduced motion, in words:
1. the primary buy moves the ticket from authority to s1 at 1.00 SOL; at or under the ceiling, so the cap admits it
2. s1 offers it to g1 at 1.27 SOL; the hook would refuse the transfer, so no custody hop is recorded
3. no hop is recorded, so the unit stays with s1 in the simulation: the dataset records hop_index null on that row
The chain drawn is the last admitted move into s1 followed by that seller's first refused attempt, so the three agents
on the rail are one ticket's story and not three unrelated rows.
